title: 明挖覆蓋隧道施工~Cut-and-cover tunnel construction
focus: 整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段~Integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels
summary: 本課以整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段為主線，從開挖尺度與地表影響與側向土壓與變形條件建立系統邊界，再把箱體自重與施工抗浮、支撐拆換與荷載轉移連到地表恢復與地下資產交接。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels. It begins with Excavation scale and surface impact and Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions, links Box weight and temporary flotation and Brace removal and load transfer, and ends with Surface restoration and underground handover. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 開挖尺度與地表影響~Excavation scale and surface impact
units.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響~Excavation scale and surface impact
units.mechanism: 明挖把地下結構施工直接連到地表交通、管線和鄰房，開挖寬度也改變支撐跨距與土體卸載。土方體積只是物流量級，不能代表所有變形風險；工法選擇應把永久箱體、臨時圍護和地表使用需求放在同一斷面。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標；若出現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Cut-and-cover directly couples underground construction to traffic, utilities and neighbours. Width changes brace spans and unloading as well as spoil volume. Volume describes logistics rather than all deformation risks; compare the permanent box, temporary retention and surface-use demands in one section. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 側向土壓與變形條件~Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions
units.title: 側向土壓與變形條件~Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions
units.mechanism: 主動土壓需要足夠牆體位移才可動員，鄰房敏感區的剛性支撐未必允許達到這個狀態。地表超載與水壓應分開處理，不能將總壓力都乘同一係數；簡化三角分布只用來理解量級，支撐牆需考慮分階段受力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對；若出現用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Active pressure requires sufficient wall movement, which stiff restraint near sensitive buildings may prevent. Treat surcharge and water separately rather than multiplying total pressure by one coefficient. A triangular diagram gives scale, while a supported wall needs staged force redistribution and movement compatibility. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions. If active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 支撐軸力與溫度~Brace force and temperature
units.title: 支撐軸力與溫度~Brace force and temperature
units.mechanism: 鋼支撐除了承受地層作用，也會隨溫度伸縮，受到拘束時產生額外軸力。荷重增加可能是熱效應而非牆後土壓增加，零點時間因此重要；比較力值要同步看溫度、牆移和接頭滑移，避免用單支荷重計判斷地層。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測支撐溫度、軸力及兩端牆體位移；若出現日照升溫造成力峰被誤判地層失穩，錯誤調整支撐，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Steel braces expand thermally and develop extra force when restrained. A force increase can reflect temperature rather than rising earth pressure, making zero time important. Compare force with temperature, wall movement and joint slip instead of diagnosing ground solely from one load cell. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure brace temperature, axial force and both wall-end movements simultaneously. If solar heating creates a force peak mistaken for ground instability and prompts an incorrect brace change, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 底部隆起與抗浮區分~Base heave and uplift distinction
units.title: 底部隆起與抗浮區分~Base heave and uplift distinction
units.mechanism: 軟黏土底部隆起與承壓水造成的水力抬升有不同機制，不能以同一重量比處理。開挖卸載降低上覆應力，地層剪切與水壓都可能變得重要；調查需把不排水強度、滲透層和測壓水位分開建模。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料；若出現把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Undrained clay heave and hydraulic uplift are different mechanisms and cannot share one simple weight ratio. Excavation removes overburden, increasing the importance of shear stability and pore pressure. Model undrained strength, permeable layers and piezometric level separately rather than merging all bottom movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare base movement, interval pore pressures and ground-strength evidence. If hydraulic uplift is treated as ordinary settlement correction without addressing the pressure source, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 箱體自重與施工抗浮~Box weight and temporary flotation
units.title: 箱體自重與施工抗浮~Box weight and temporary flotation
units.mechanism: 永久覆土可提供重量，但施工中尚未回填時並不存在這份抗浮作用。空箱體、局部回填與封頂後各有不同邊界，水位也可能回升；重量帳必須只計入當階段確實存在且可傳力的部分，不得提前借用竣工狀態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位；若出現尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Permanent cover supplies weight but is absent before backfilling. Empty boxes, partial fill and completed roofs have different boundaries and may encounter rising groundwater. Count only weight physically present and connected in each stage rather than borrowing resistance from the completed structure. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage. If using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 防水接縫與穿牆構件~Waterproof joints and penetrations
units.title: 防水接縫與穿牆構件~Waterproof joints and penetrations
units.mechanism: 明挖箱體常有施工縫、伸縮縫及大量管線穿牆，止水連續性由這些界面控制。接縫位移與水壓可能同時存在，單獨材料試驗不能證明安裝系統；驗證需把預埋位置、固定狀態及兩側結構變形連在一起。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄；若出現穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Cut-and-cover boxes contain construction joints, movement joints and penetrations that govern waterproof continuity. Movement and pressure can coexist, so isolated material tests do not prove installation. Link embedded position, restraint and deformation of adjacent structure rather than checking the seal alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records. If a discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：jointStrain=movement/freeSealLength=4 mm/80 mm=0.05。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: jointStrain=movement/freeSealLength=4 mm/80 mm=0.05. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~A discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 箱體牆面不裂就能保證所有穿牆位置都不漏~Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight
units.practice: 將核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 支撐拆換與荷載轉移~Brace removal and load transfer
units.title: 支撐拆換與荷載轉移~Brace removal and load transfer
units.mechanism: 臨時支撐拆除將側向荷載轉到永久樓板和牆，混凝土齡期與接頭完成度決定能否接手。竣工樓板存在不代表當天已具備預期剛度，開口也會切斷壓力路徑；拆換模型需按實際順序逐階段檢核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變；若出現接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Removing temporary braces transfers lateral actions to slabs and walls whose age and joint completion govern engagement. A slab's presence does not prove its intended stiffness, and openings interrupt compression paths. Assess removal in the actual sequence rather than using only the final configuration. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. If removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 永久樓板澆置完成就能立即取代全部臨時支撐~A freshly cast permanent slab immediately replaces every temporary brace
units.practice: 將對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 鄰房沉陷與角變形~Neighbour settlement and angular distortion
units.title: 鄰房沉陷與角變形~Neighbour settlement and angular distortion
units.mechanism: 總沉陷與差異沉陷對建物的影響不同，剛體下沉可能不造成同樣裂縫，而局部角變形會擠壓門窗或拉開砌體。量測點需與建物結構分區相連，原有裂縫也應先記錄；不能把單一最大沉陷值當成全部損傷指標。兩測點沉陷差除跨距是平均沉陷坡度；要判別造成損傷的角變形，還須區分整體剛體傾斜與局部變形。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較；若出現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Total and differential settlements affect buildings differently: rigid movement can produce less cracking than local distortion. Connect survey points to structural divisions and document existing cracks. One maximum settlement value does not capture deformation patterns or establish damage causation by itself. Settlement difference divided by span is a mean settlement slope; damage-related angular distortion requires separating overall rigid-body tilt from local deformation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay. If small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=settlementDifference/span=6 mm/12000 mm=0.0005 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=settlementDifference/span=6 mm/12000 mm=0.0005 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷~Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings
units.practice: 將將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 回填壓實與箱頂荷載~Backfill compaction and roof loading
units.title: 回填壓實與箱頂荷載~Backfill compaction and roof loading
units.mechanism: 回填不只增加永久覆土，也會帶來施工機具與壓實作用；不對稱堆置可使箱體受扭或側壓不均。填料剛度與排水影響後續沉陷，不能只看壓實度數字；施工階段的機具位置和覆土厚度需要一起核對。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變；若出現薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Backfill adds construction plant and compaction effects as well as permanent overburden; asymmetric placement changes lateral loading. Fill stiffness and drainage govern later settlement, beyond one density result. Check plant position and cover depth together when assessing temporary roof demand. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. If concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：overburdenPressure=unitWeight*depth=20 kN/m3*2 m=40 kPa。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: overburdenPressure=unitWeight*depth=20 kN/m3*2 m=40 kPa. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 回填越快完成就能保證施工階段更安全~Faster completion of backfilling guarantees safer construction stages
units.practice: 將對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 地表恢復與地下資產交接~Surface restoration and underground handover
units.title: 地表恢復與地下資產交接~Surface restoration and underground handover
units.mechanism: 道路恢復後，地下接縫、排水和檢查孔可能變得難以接近，維護動線須在交接時確認。竣工圖應記錄實際高程與管線改道，不能只保留原設計；地表平順也不能證明回填長期不沉陷，需建立後續比較基準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點；若出現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~After road restoration, joints, drains and access points become harder to reach, making maintenance access part of handover. Record as-built levels and utility diversions rather than design alone. A smooth surface does not establish long-term fill stability, so retain a postconstruction baseline. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查開挖尺度與地表影響：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3；再獨立檢查側向土壓與變形條件：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。長 100 m、深 8 m，寬由 14 增為 16 m，土方由 11200 增為 12800 m3，增加 14.3%；支撐跨距及水力影響不只按體積同比放大。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 將將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Excavation scale and surface impact: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3. Independently check Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m. At 100 m length and 8 m depth, widening from 14 to 16 m raises excavation from 11200 to 12800 m3, by 14.3%; brace spans and hydraulic effects do not merely scale with volume. The two results are not a complete design because excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. Use compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。大開挖公開資料列有明挖、沉管與頂進；帕丁頓專案團隊則說明永久樓板支撐連續壁的逆打選擇理由，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Big Dig public information lists cut-and-cover, immersed and jacked works; the Paddington project team explains choosing top-down construction with permanent slabs bracing diaphragm walls. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
